input.oldString:
echo "Proprietary Software Scanner for Linux"
echo "======================================"
echo "Scanning installed packages for potentially proprietary software..."
echo ""

# Get list of foreign packages (not from official repos)
foreign_packages=$(pacman -Q --foreign | awk '{print $1}')

total_packages=$(pacman -Q | wc -l)
foreign_count=$(echo "$foreign_packages" | wc -l)
echo "Total installed packages: $total_packages"
echo "Packages from unofficial sources: $foreign_count"
echo ""

if [[ $foreign_count -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "Potentially proprietary packages (from AUR or other sources):"
    echo ""
    for pkg in $foreign_packages; do
        echo "- $pkg"
    done
else
    echo "No packages from unofficial sources found."
fi

echo ""
echo "Scan complete."
echo ""
echo "Note: This tool flags packages not from official repositories."
echo "Unofficial packages may include proprietary software. Check licenses manually for accuracy."
input.newString:
echo "Proprietary Software Scanner for Linux"
echo "======================================"
echo "Scanning installed packages and Flatpak apps for potentially proprietary software..."
echo ""

# Get list of foreign packages (not from official repos)
foreign_packages=$(pacman -Q --foreign | awk '{print $1}')

total_packages=$(pacman -Q | wc -l)
foreign_count=$(echo "$foreign_packages" | wc -l)
echo "Total installed packages: $total_packages"
echo "Packages from unofficial sources: $foreign_count"
echo ""

if [[ $foreign_count -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "Potentially proprietary packages (from AUR or other sources):"
    echo ""
    for pkg in $foreign_packages; do
        echo "- $pkg"
    done
else
    echo "No packages from unofficial sources found."
fi

echo ""

# Check for Flatpak support
if command -v flatpak &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Flatpak detected. Scanning installed applications..."
    flatpak_apps=$(flatpak list --app --columns=application | tail -n +1)
    flatpak_count=$(echo "$flatpak_apps" | wc -l)
    echo "Installed Flatpak applications: $flatpak_count"
    echo ""

    if [[ $flatpak_count -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Flatpak applications (may include proprietary software):"
        echo ""
        for app in $flatpak_apps; do
            echo "- $app"
        done
    else
        echo "No Flatpak applications installed."
    fi
else
    echo "Flatpak not installed or not in PATH."
fi

echo ""
echo "Scan complete."
echo ""
echo "Note: This tool flags packages not from official repositories and all Flatpak apps."
echo "Unofficial packages and Flatpak apps may include proprietary software. Check licenses manually for accuracy."
